children: Cannabis Suisse Corp. reported fiscal 2026 results showing revenue of $21000 and net income of $122739 compared with revenue of $22500 and a net loss of $(456,142) in FY2025; diluted earnings per share were $0 for FY2026 versus $(0.01) in the prior year.
Revenue was $21,000 for FY2026, down from $22,500 in FY2025 (6.7%).
Net income was $122,739 for FY2026, compared with a net loss of $(456,142) in FY2025 (improvement of $578,881).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.00 for FY2026, compared with $(0.01) for FY2025.
Since June 2022 the company shifted its focus from cannabis operations to real estate activities, concentrating on leasing and subleasing properties.
Rental income modestly declined following a prior sublease termination; the company recognized $21,000 of rental income in FY2026 and began a new sublease in March 2026.
The company leased four properties from entities controlled by the CEO in February 2023 and February 2024 to support current operations and planned expansion.
Operations remain dependent on advances from the CEO and related parties, and management is pursuing financing to stabilize funding for leasing activities.
